comment: The 7 benchmark environments in the current paper draft. Titles and short labels follow the canonical paper-facing names in medcli-paper-latex/main.tex. `metricsKey` links the environment to results.json, `taskCount` follows the auto-generated counts in medcli-paper-latex/figures/coverage_data.tex, and `group` (image|text) drives the modality split in the heat-circle chart.

families.title: X-ray Report Correction
families.blurb: Review a counterfactual chest X-ray Findings draft against the target study and longitudinal history, then write the corrected report section. Task success criteria: 0 errors in the corrected report.

families.title: Pathology Tumor Area Selection
families.blurb: Inspect a gigapixel pathology slide and predict the set of tumor tiles on a fixed analysis grid. Success criteria: 0.9 tile F1.

families.title: CT Abnormality Classification
families.blurb: Interpret a chest CT volume and emit a per-volume yes/no label vector for the report-grounded abnormality findings. Success criteria: 1.0 accuracy.

families.title: EHR Data Quality Auditing
families.blurb: Audit a corrupted EHR corpus that contin errors and flag the offending rows. Success criteria: 1.0 recall and > 0.01 precision.

families.title: EHR Format Conversion
families.blurb: Customize a real MEDS ETL repository so it emits the required transformed cohort from raw demo EHR input. Success criteria: output exact match.

families.title: EHR Event Modelling
families.blurb: Learn a prediction strategy from longitudinal event timelines and output held-out patient risk scrores. Success rate: Match human engineered baseline.

families.title: Clinical Trial Matching
families.blurb: Rank candidate clinical-trial IDs for a patient profile by eligibility confidence over a trial pool. Success criteria: 1.0 recall@50.
